title: Algebraic and independent coefficient fields; overlapping polynomial-direction outputs

newly_used_primary_inputs.exact_import: Stacks Theorem 10.34.1(1), tag 00FV: maximal residue fields of a finite-type algebra over a field are finite extensions of that field. Over an algebraically closed field every nonzero finite-type algebra, including a finite localization, therefore has a rational closed point.
newly_used_primary_inputs.portions_inspected: Complete theorem statement and proof; only the finite-type closed-point implication is imported.
